title: Animals
content: I’ve been having the same recurring “Mall World” dreamscape for years. It’s always this massive, liminal, half-abandoned indoor/outdoor complex that feels like a hybrid of a shopping mall, resort, apartment building, and weird forgotten attractions. Same vibe every time, I just pop in and out of different sections of it. But this past week or two the dreams have taken a sharp turn, and I’m wondering if anyone else has experienced their recurring dream world suddenly developing a new “theme.” Basically, animals (especially snakes, chickens, and monkey-human hybrids) have taken over the narrative. Examples from just the last few nights: 1. I wandered into an outdoor area that felt like an abandoned zoo exhibit – cracked concrete amphitheater-style seating, totally overgrown with vines and trees, leading down to a pit. Tons of snakes everywhere. Later in the same dream, snakes started coming out of my mouth and… uh… my butt. Like, endlessly. I was just calmly coughing them up and yanking them out, yeeting them across the room like it was the most normal Tuesday ever. Zero panic, just mild annoyance. 2. Same night, different dream in the same Mall World – suddenly I’m chasing full-grown chickens through the apartment hallways, hotel corridors, and mall atrium. No idea why. 3. Two separate dreams involving hybrids; one with monkey-human genetic hybrids and the other was wormlike creatures.
